Why This Is Asked

Key Concepts

- Edge inference with SageMaker Edge Manager
- PrivateLink and VPC isolation
- Per-tenant model registry/versioning
- Drift detection and monitoring
- Canary rollout and auto-rollback
- Data lineage and reproducibility (CloudTrail, artifact versioning)

Code Example

```javascript
// CDK-like snippet illustrating per-tenant model deployment
const model = new sageMaker.CfnModel(this, 'TenantModel', {

});
```
